::: {.hero-banner}
# PHYD57H3: Advanced Computational Methods in Physics
### Department of Physical and Environmental Sciences — UTSC
Comprehensive portal for computational physics, large-scale simulations, vectorization, multi-threading (OpenMP/MPI), and numerical solutions to physical field equations in Python, C, and Fortran.
:::

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.course-card}
### 💻 [Lecture Notes](notes/index.qmd)
In-depth treatment of ODE integration (Runge-Kutta, Symplectic Verlet), elliptic/parabolic/hyperbolic PDEs, spectral methods (FFT), and Monte Carlo algorithms.
:::

::: {.course-card}
### 🚀 [Computational Projects](assignments/index.qmd)
Full implementations of gravitational N-body integrators, 2D Navier-Stokes fluid simulations, Poisson potential solvers, and machine learning physics surrogates.
:::

::: {.course-card}
### ⚙️ [HPC & Code Lab](code/index.qmd)
High-performance computing workflows: parallel computing with OpenMP and MPI, SIMD vectorization, memory cache optimization, and Python/C interoperability.
:::
:::

## Course Curriculum & Numerical Methods

| Module | Scientific Topics | Numerical Algorithms | Languages & Frameworks |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **01: Advanced ODEs** | Planetary orbits, chaotic attractors, stiff chemical kinetics | Adaptive RK45, Symplectic Velocity-Verlet, Radau/BDF | Python, NumPy, SciPy |
| **02: Elliptic PDEs** | Electrostatic & Gravitational Potentials ($\nabla^2 \phi = \rho$) | Finite difference, Successive Over-Relaxation (SOR), Multigrid | C / Python |
| **03: Parabolic PDEs** | Heat conduction, diffusion, quantum Schrödinger evolution | FTCS stability, Crank-Nicolson implicit method | Python, C |
| **04: Hyperbolic PDEs** | Sound waves, shock waves, electromagnetism | Lax-Friedrichs, Godunov, flux limiters | Fortran / C |
| **05: N-Body & Fluids** | Galactic collisions, fluid dynamics | Barnes-Hut tree code, Particle-Mesh (PM), Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) | Python, OpenMP |
| **06: HPC & Parallelism** | Shared and distributed memory scaling | OpenMP multithreading, MPI message passing, cache profiling | Linux, GCC, Slurm |
